what: The Route 91 fuel stop's lot (NMC H9, the owner's ruling of 11-14: a mix of concrete and asphalt with painted lines for parking and lanes, pump pads). World metres, y north; laid from the fuel stop kit's site plan (docs/art/rigs/fuel-stop/nmcFuelStop.js NETS, key scene = site + (-174, 87)). tools/nmc-roads/network.cjs copies it into the network's forecourt section, expanding the bays into stall lines; tools/nmc-roads/bake-chunks.cjs lays its routes after the network's and paints its lines, bays and arrows onto them. Every route is a kit v4 route: cls is the kit class it inherits from and the keys after it override that class.
area: inside NineMileCreekWharfLandSide.ForecourtArea(), except the lot's south edge, which reaches entrySouthOverlap into Wharf Road's carriage (the entry), and the exit, which runs into the stream lane

routes.why: the forecourt's whole ground, under everything else here (its own group, the lowest priority): the strip east of the pads, round the truck bays and under the store, which the kit v3 pad used to pave in concrete and nothing else now does
the driving surface: the entry off Wharf Road along the whole frontage, round the pads and the aisle in front of the store
the kit's semi exit, north-east past the east light onto the stream lane by the stop sign
the kit's service lane up the store's east side to the air and vacuum, ending at the lot's north edge
the pickups' bays, north of the aisle between the service lane and the exit
the pump pad under the canopy, the four car lanes and their three islands
the semi lanes' pad under the truck canopy, its islands and the start of the exit
the kit's tank pad: the fill ports between the pump pads
the concrete apron at the shop door, from the sidewalk out across the head of the store bays
the raised island under pump machine 1 (the canopy's west island)
the raised island under pump machine 2
the raised island under pump machine 3
the raised island under the semi lane's west pumps
the raised island under the semi lane's east pumps
the kit's store sidewalk, kerbed, under the propane, the ice and the bench

paint.colourWhy: the kit's own road paint (roadPathRig4.js PALS): W #d4d6cd, Y #cea53f

bays.why: the store front's stalls, centred on the kit's eight wheel stops: the quad (1.28 x 2.16 m), the trike and the bikes, or a car
two pickup bays: wider than the widest pickup (the Dually 3500, 2.72 m over its mirrors) and longer than the longest (the Modern 3500, 7.09 m)

lines.why: the stop bar across the exit's outbound half, at the stop sign
the lot's west edge line, inside the west light
